links.comparator_used: Initial prompt before prompt engineering (pre-engineering baseline) for MEWS-based triage
links.outcome: MEWS-based triage accuracy (and consistency) on 1854 simulated scenarios
links.effect: Accuracy improved after prompt engineering; post-engineering GPT-4-Turbo reached 100% vs GPT-4o 96.2%. Pre-engineering figures not given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Gains differed by model: GPT-4o performed better before prompt engineering but gained less afterwards, so adaptability to prompt optimization varied. No cost or latency reported.
links.quote: In the first phase, ChatGPT's triage accuracy, based on MEWS, improved following prompt engineering.

design_hint: prompt engineering to improve triage accuracy
